source_caption_text:
Lil Baby slid on this fr 😤🔥

Central Cee and Lil Baby bring “Band4Band” to the stage for Apple Music Live, giving the track a much more energetic feel than the studio version. The two trade verses back and forth while the crowd adds to the energy, making the performance feel like a real back-and-forth between UK and Atlanta rap.

Central Cee keeps his sharp UK delivery while Lil Baby brings his laid-back Atlanta flow, and the contrast between their styles works just as well live. The chemistry between the two is what makes the performance stand out, especially when they go line for line.

“Band4Band” became one of the biggest cross-Atlantic rap collaborations of its time, and this live version gives fans a chance to hear the two artists perform it together on the same stage. It’s a strong reminder of how naturally UK and US rap can come together when the artists actually match each other’s energy.

Via @applemusic
